[[Zygerria Four]] underwent an '''orbital bombardment''' during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] that ravaged the surface in an attempt to drive out the [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] who had settled there, destroying many slave trader palaces and exposing the ruins of an underground city. Scavengers and archaeologists alike surveyed the ruins and damaged buildings.
